name: dsh-space-cognition-suite
description: J-Space Cognition Suite as a DSH plugin — an inference-time cognitive control layer. On every session it injects a compact J-Space activation header (premise, gate, module index, invariants), registers a `jspace` ledger tool wrapping the bundled jspace.py controller, and syncs the j-space skill into the agent skills directory (default ~/.agents/skills/j-space) for skill-aware hosts.
